description: This PHP class 'InAccessibleEntityIdOption' appears to define configuration options for access control related to entity IDs, including permissions, roles, and exception handling within the OrangeHRM system's validation rules.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityIdOption
classes.description: Defines validation rules and configuration for entity access control, including permissions, roles, and exception handling.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the exception object used for validation failures, initializing a default ForbiddenException if none is set.

methods.name: setThrowable
methods.description: Sets a custom exception object for validation failures.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the current exception message string.

methods.name: isThrow
methods.description: Checks whether exceptions should be thrown.

methods.name: setThrow
methods.description: Configures whether to throw exceptions on validation failures.

methods.name: isThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Determines if exceptions should be thrown when only the entity exists.

methods.name: setThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Sets whether to throw exceptions when only the entity exists.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of permissions required for access.

methods.name: setRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Specifies the permissions required for access.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Gets the list of roles to exclude from access.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets roles to exclude from access.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Gets the list of roles to include for access.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets roles to include for access.
